evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Physical risk — wildfire exposure in southern portfolio

claims.claim_text: Scenario analysis is used to assess resilience; the bank applies multiple NGFS v4 scenarios to the banking book and links scenario outputs to risk transmission channels.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Climate resilience and scenario analysis
claims.support_notes: Use of scenario analysis for resilience is explicitly stated.

claims.claim_text: NGFS v4 Net Zero 2050 scenario is applied using a top-down sector-pathway approach; carbon price assumptions are mapped from the IEA NZE 2050 trajectory to counterparty NACE sectors; stranded asset estimates are derived from sector-level fossil fuel capex exposure; scope covers all lending book exposures across DE, FR, IT, NL, ES.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Scenario analysis approach and scope - NGFS v4 Net Zero 2050 scenario
claims.support_notes: Method and geographic scope are explicitly described.

claims.claim_text: NGFS v4 Below 2°C (orderly) scenario uses NGFS IAM outputs aligned to a 1.8°C median temperature pathway with carbon price trajectory from the REMIND-MAgPIE model; financial impact assessed through loan-level PD sensitivity to carbon cost pass-through by sector carbon intensity tier.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Scenario analysis approach and scope - NGFS v4 Below 2°C (orderly) scenario
claims.support_notes: Key modelling components and metric (PD sensitivity) are stated.

claims.claim_text: NGFS v4 NDC scenario assumes carbon pricing ramp-up from 2030 onward based on Paris Agreement NDC submission trajectories; revenue-at-risk is computed from sector revenue sensitivity to carbon price at EUR/tCO2e levels specified in the scenario.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Scenario analysis approach and scope - NGFS v4 NDC scenario
claims.support_notes: Start date for ramp-up and revenue-at-risk computation basis are stated.

claims.claim_text: NGFS v4 Current Policies (hot house world) scenario uses RCP 8.5 physical risk projections for the 2050 horizon; physical risk parameters are sourced from NGFS hazard layers and downscaled to counterparty postcode and collateral location.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Scenario analysis approach and scope - NGFS v4 Current Policies (hot house world) scenario
claims.support_notes: Physical scenario choice and downscaling approach are explicitly stated.
